# Kronos Fusion Energy — AI-native architecture & knowledge base

> Kronos Fusion Energy is a family-owned American fusion company: a D–T spherical-tokamak breeder (HYPERION) that makes tritium and helium-3, and a low-neutron D–³He tandem-mirror burner (Aegis / MetroVolt). This file lists the pages of the /ai section for AI crawlers and assistants. Public physics is open; economics are not published.

## Pages
- [Kronos AI-Native Architecture](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai): How Kronos applies AI, machine learning, and quantum computing to fusion — an 8-layer architecture (L0 Foundation → L7 Ecosystem) wired into both machines: the breeder (Hyperion) and the burner. Not a computing textbook;
- [A* Search · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/a-star): A* finds a shortest path to a goal by guiding Dijkstra&#x27;s search with an admissible heuristic that estimates the remaining distance.
- [Tracing A* on a Grid · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/a-star-grid-trace): Search a small grid with obstacles using A*, combining path cost and a heuristic to find the shortest route efficiently.
- [A/B and Interleaving Evaluation Offline](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ab-interleaving-offline): Since live A/B on a single machine is unsafe, Kronos compares models by counterfactual replay on the twin and by matched shadow evaluation, not by splitting live traffic.
- [ABC Decomposition of Controlled Gates · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/abc-controlled-gate-decomposition): The construction that realizes any controlled single-qubit gate with only two CNOTs plus single-qubit rotations.
- [Abstraction and Modularity · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/abstraction-and-modularity): Hiding detail behind clean boundaries lets large systems be understood, built, and changed one piece at a time.
- [Accelerating the Design Cycle · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/accelerating-design-cycles): Computing compresses the loop from idea to evaluated design from months to days, so more ideas get tested and better ones survive.
- [Acceptance Criteria and Tolerances · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/acceptance-criteria-and-tolerances): Deciding in advance how much error or discrepancy is acceptable turns V&amp;V evidence into a defensible pass-or-fail decision.
- [Access Control: RBAC and ABAC · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/access-control-rbac-abac): Access-control models decide whether a principal may perform an action on a resource, from coarse role grants to fine-grained attribute rules.
- [Accessibility and Colorblind-Safe Design](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/accessibility-colorblind-safe): The control room must work for every operator on every shift: redundant encodings, sufficient contrast, and legibility that does not depend on color vision.
- [Accessibility in Data Visualization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/accessibility-in-data-viz): Accessible visualization ensures that color-vision differences, low vision, and non-visual access do not exclude readers from the data.
- [Acquisition Functions · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/acquisition-functions): The decision rule of Bayesian optimization: score candidate points by expected usefulness to balance exploration and exploitation.
- [Action-Gating Pipeline](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/action-gating-pipeline): Every candidate action passes a fixed, ordered sequence of independent checks; any stage can reject, and rejection is the default.
- [Activation and Material Damage Modeling](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/activation-and-damage-modeling): Turning neutron flux into activation inventories and displacement damage for the breeder blanket and burner structure over their lives.
- [Activation and Dose Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/activation-and-dose-codes): Activation codes compute the radioactive inventory that neutrons induce in materials, and dose codes turn that inventory into radiation fields for shielding and safety.
- [Activation Function · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/activation-function): The nonlinear function applied at each neuron that lets networks represent nonlinear relationships.
- [Activation Functions · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/activation-functions): Activation functions inject the nonlinearity that gives deep networks their expressive power, and their shape controls how gradients flow.
- [Activation and Inventory Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/activation-inventory-codes): Activation codes evolve the nuclide inventory of materials under neutron irradiation, predicting radioactivity, decay heat, and waste classification over time.
- [Active Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-learning): Active learning lets a model choose which unlabeled examples to have labeled, spending scarce annotation where it helps most.
- [Active Learning for Costly Experiments · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-learning-costly-experiments): Active learning chooses which expensive simulations or discharges to run next, extracting the most information per costly evaluation.
- [Active Learning and Experiment Design](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-learning-experiment-design): Active learning turns model uncertainty into experiment proposals, so scarce machine time is spent where new data most improves the models that run the machines.
- [Active Learning in Experiment Loops · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-learning-experiment-loops): Letting a model choose its own next training example so it learns the most from the fewest expensive runs.
- [Active Learning for Labeling · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-learning-for-labeling): Active learning chooses which unlabeled examples to annotate next so a model reaches target accuracy with far fewer labels.
- [Active Learning for Surrogates · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-learning-surrogates): Active learning chooses where to run an expensive simulation next, so a surrogate improves fastest with the fewest costly evaluations.
- [Active Qubit Reset · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-qubit-reset): Active reset deterministically returns a qubit to its ground state in microseconds, instead of waiting many relaxation times for passive decay.
- [Active Subspaces · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/active-subspaces): Active subspaces find the few input directions along which a function changes most, collapsing high-dimensional problems onto a low-dimensional ridge.
- [Synchronized Actuation Gates](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/actuation-gate-synchronization): Commands do not reach actuators the instant they are computed; they pass a synchronized gate that admits them only in a valid window and only when all interlocks agree.
- [Actuator Command Arbitration](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/actuator-command-arbitration): When multiple controllers request the same actuator, L1 arbitrates by fixed priority so protection always outranks optimization.
- [Actuator Interfaces · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/actuator-interfaces): Actuators turn control commands into physical action; the interface must convert, amplify, and safely drive them while confirming what actually happened.
- [Actuator Management and Allocation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/actuator-management-allocation): Mapping many competing control demands onto a limited set of shared, constrained actuators without violating hardware limits.
- [AdaGrad · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adagrad): Adapt a per-parameter learning rate by dividing by the accumulated history of squared gradients, favoring rarely updated directions.
- [Adam · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adam-optimizer): Combine momentum and per-parameter adaptive scaling with bias correction: the default optimizer for training deep neural networks.
- [An Adam Optimizer Step · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adam-optimizer-step): Apply one Adam update with worked numbers, tracking the bias-corrected first and second moment estimates.
- [AdamW · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adamw): Adam with decoupled weight decay: apply regularization directly to the parameters instead of folding it into the adaptive gradient.
- [AdamW Optimizer · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adamw-optimizer): AdamW fixes how Adam applies weight decay, decoupling it from the adaptive gradient scaling to make regularization behave as intended.
- [Adaptive Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adaptive-control): Adaptive controllers adjust their own parameters online as the plant changes, maintaining performance without a fixed model.
- [Adaptive Mesh Refinement · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adaptive-mesh-refinement): Adaptive mesh refinement concentrates grid resolution where the solution varies rapidly and coarsens it where the solution is smooth.
- [Adaptive Quadrature · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adaptive-quadrature): Numerical integration that automatically refines where the integrand varies rapidly and coarsens where it is smooth.
- [Adaptive Sampling · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adaptive-sampling): Adaptive sampling adds training points sequentially where a surrogate is weakest, balancing exploration of unseen regions against refinement of complex ones.
- [Adaptive Sampling and Active Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adaptive-sampling-active-learning): Active learning chooses the next expensive evaluation where it most improves the surrogate, building accurate models from few runs.
- [Adaptive Step-Size Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adaptive-step-ode): Adaptive ODE solvers estimate local error each step and adjust the step size to hold error near a tolerance, saving work where the solution is smooth.
- [ADC Quantization & Dynamic Range](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adc-quantization-dynamic-range): Digitization trades continuous voltage for discrete counts; the fabric sizes bit depth and range so quantization noise never limits a physics inference.
- [Adder Circuit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adder-circuit-glossary): A combinational circuit that adds binary numbers, the arithmetic core of a processor.
- [Adiabatic Demagnetization Refrigeration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adiabatic-demagnetization): Adiabatic demagnetization cools by aligning and then slowly randomizing magnetic moments, reaching microkelvin temperatures below the range of dilution refrigerators.
- [Adiabatic State Preparation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adiabatic-state-preparation): Reaching a hard-to-prepare ground state by starting easy and deforming slowly, guided by the adiabatic theorem.
- [Adjoint-Based UQ · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adjoint-based-uq): Adjoint methods compute the sensitivity of an output to all inputs at a cost independent of the number of inputs, powering efficient local UQ.
- [The Adjoint Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adjoint-method): A technique to compute the gradient of a scalar objective with respect to many parameters at a cost independent of the parameter count.
- [The Adjoint Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adjoint-method-ml): The adjoint method computes the gradient of an objective with respect to many parameters at a cost independent of the number of parameters.
- [Advanced Capabilities](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/advanced-capabilities): The roadmap — formal assurance, physics-fidelity twins, stronger algorithms, and fleet-scale trust. We publish the gaps, not just the wins: each is real, sequenced to a milestone,
- [GAIL: Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adversarial-imitation-gail): GAIL imitates an expert by matching state-action distributions through an adversarial game, skipping explicit reward recovery.
- [Adversarial-Input Defense for Control Models](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adversarial-ml-defense): Learned components are hardened against crafted inputs, and physics-based sanity bounds ensure a fooled model still cannot request an unsafe action.
- [Agentic Tool-Use With Bounded Actions](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/agentic-tool-use-bounded-actions): Every copilot action is a typed, bounded tool call — read, simulate, or propose — with no tool that writes directly to the plant.
- [Aho-Corasick Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/aho-corasick): A multi-pattern string matcher that builds an automaton over a trie with failure links to scan text in linear time.
- [The AI-Native S.M.A.R.T. Generator Master Blueprint](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ai-native-master-blueprint): One architecture, eight layers, wired end-to-end into two fusion machines — the breeder (Hyperion) and the burner (Aegis / MetroVolt).
- [AI-Ready Structured Features](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ai-ready-features): The fabric's output is a pristine, structured, quality-tagged feature set — the clean interface every L3 model and copilot is built on.
- [Air Gaps and Controlled Bridging](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/airgaps-and-bridging): The safety and control core is air-gapped from routable networks; the rare crossing to update a model or policy is a deliberate, two-person, fully logged event.
- [Alarm Flood Suppression and Dynamic Shelving](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alarm-flood-suppression): During an upset one root cause can trigger hundreds of correlated alarms; suppression logic collapses them so the operator sees the cause, not the cascade.
- [Alarm Management and Rationalization](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alarm-management-eemua191): Applying established alarm-management principles so every alarm is meaningful, prioritized, and actionable — never a wall of noise an operator learns to ignore.
- [Aleatoric versus Epistemic Uncertainty · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/aleatoric-vs-epistemic-uncertainty): Aleatoric uncertainty is inherent randomness you cannot reduce; epistemic uncertainty is ignorance you can reduce with more data or better models.
- [Aleatory vs Epistemic Uncertainty · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/aleatory-vs-epistemic-uncertainty): Some uncertainty is genuine randomness that cannot be reduced; some is ignorance that more information removes. The distinction changes what to do.
- [Alerting and Triage UX](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alerting-triage-ux): Turning anomaly detections, precursors, and interlock events into a ranked, deduplicated, actionable stream an operator can work top-down under pressure.
- [Alfven Wave Equations · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alfven-wave-equations): The transverse magnetic-tension wave of MHD, and the eigenmodes it forms in a nonuniform confined plasma.
- [Alfven Waves · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alfven-waves): Transverse waves that travel along magnetic field lines as if they were tensioned strings.
- [Algebraic Multigrid · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/algebraic-multigrid): A multilevel solver that builds its coarse problems purely from the matrix entries, needing no knowledge of the underlying geometry.
- [Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/algorithm-glossary): A finite, unambiguous procedure that transforms inputs into outputs to solve a problem.
- [Algorithmic Complexity · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/algorithmic-complexity): Complexity describes how an algorithm’s time and memory grow with problem size, which decides what is feasible at scale.
- [Aliasing and Anti-Alias Filtering · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/aliasing-and-anti-alias-filtering): Frequencies above half the sampling rate masquerade as lower ones; an analog filter before the sampler is the only way to prevent this corruption.
- [AlphaZero · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alphazero-and-mcts): AlphaZero replaces MCTS rollouts with a learned network and trains purely by self-play from the rules alone.
- [Alternating Least Squares · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alternating-least-squares): ALS fits matrix-factorization models by alternately solving closed-form least-squares problems for each factor.
- [Arithmetic Logic Unit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alu): An ALU is the combinational core of a processor that performs arithmetic and logic operations selected by control lines.
- [Arithmetic Logic Unit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alu-glossary): The processor component that performs arithmetic and logical operations on binary data.
- [Ambipolar Diffusion · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-diffusion): The self-regulating diffusion in which electrons and ions leave together at a common rate set by a self-consistent field.
- [Ambipolar Potential Electrode Interface](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-electrode-interface): Biased electrodes and plug heating shape the electrostatic potential that plugs the tandem mirror; the interface senses and drives that potential.
- [Ambipolar Potential Control](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-potential-control): The electrostatic potential profile confines the burner's central cell; L1 regulates the ambipolar potential through plug conditions to hold axial confinement.
- [Ambipolar Potential and Pastukhov Confinement](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-potential-mathematics): The tandem mirror confines ions with an electrostatic potential set by charge neutrality; the Pastukhov relation ties confinement time to that potential.
- [Ambipolar Potential Safety Envelope](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-potential-safety-envelope): Tandem-mirror confinement lives or dies on the end-plug ambipolar potential; the safety envelope bounds it against a rapid confinement-loss transient.
- [Ambipolar Potential Solver](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-potential-solver): Computing the electrostatic barriers that plug the burner's magnetic mirror, the control problem at the heart of tandem-mirror confinement.
- [Amdahl's and Gustafson's Laws · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amdahl-gustafson): Amdahl&#x27;s law bounds speedup when a serial fraction is fixed; Gustafson&#x27;s law shows scaling improves when the problem grows with the processors.
- [Amdahl's Law · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amdahls-law): A formula bounding the speedup from parallelization by the fraction of work that stays sequential.
- [Algebraic Multigrid · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amg-algebraic-multigrid): Algebraic multigrid builds a coarse-grid hierarchy from the matrix entries alone, extending multigrid to unstructured and irregular problems.
- [Amortized Analysis · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amortized-analysis): Amortized analysis measures the average cost per operation over a sequence, showing that occasional expensive operations are cheap on average.
- [Amplitude Amplification · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amplitude-amplification-general): The general procedure behind Grover search: boosting the amplitude of a marked subspace by iterated reflections.
- [The Amplitude-Damping Channel · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amplitude-damping-channel): Amplitude damping models energy loss, the decay of an excited qubit toward its ground state, capturing T1 relaxation.
- [Amplitude Estimation Without Phase Estimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amplitude-estimation-without-phase-estimation): Near-term variants recover the marked amplitude from Grover-power measurements, avoiding the deep quantum Fourier transform.
- [Analog Front-End and Calibration Interface](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/analog-front-end-calibration-interface): Between raw sensor and digital sample sits the analog front end; its interface defines conditioning, ADC quantization, and the calibration chain.
- [Analog Quantum Simulation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/analog-quantum-simulation): Engineering a controllable quantum device whose native dynamics directly emulate a target Hamiltonian, without decomposing into gates.
- [Analog-to-Digital Conversion · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/analog-to-digital-conversion): An ADC samples an analog signal and encodes it as a number; its architecture sets the trade-off between speed, resolution, and latency.
- [Analytical Solutions as Benchmarks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/analytical-solutions-as-benchmarks): Exact closed-form solutions of simplified problems provide ground truth for verification without needing a manufactured source.
- [Ancilla and Qubit Budgets · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ancilla-and-qubit-budgets): Accounting for the extra qubits algorithms need beyond the system register, and the overhead multiplier that error correction imposes.
- [AND Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/and-gate): The AND gate outputs 1 only when all of its inputs are 1, implementing logical conjunction.
- [Andrew's Monotone Chain · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/andrew-monotone-chain-hull): A convex hull algorithm that sorts points by coordinate and builds the lower and upper hulls in one linear pass each.
- [Annotation and Collaborative Markup](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/annotation-and-collaboration): Shared, persistent annotations let the crew point at the same thing, capture judgment, and hand off context across shifts and between control room and mobile.
- [Autoencoder Reconstruction Residuals](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-autoencoder-residual): Autoencoders learn the manifold of normal operation and flag anything they cannot faithfully reconstruct, catching novel precursors without labeled failures.
- [Anomaly Detection · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-detection): Anomaly detection flags rare, unexpected observations, usually with few or no labeled examples of the anomalies.
- [Anomaly-Detection Ensembles](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-detection-ensembles): No single detector is reliable enough for safety-relevant precursors, so Kronos combines reconstruction, density, and forecasting detectors into a calibrated ensemble.
- [Anomaly Detection in Operations · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-detection-in-operations): Anomaly detection flags behavior that departs from the learned normal, catching problems that no one wrote an explicit rule for.

- [Anomaly Detection on Machine Subsystems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-detection-subsystems): Unsupervised models learn normal behavior of machine subsystems and flag deviations that may signal faults before they cause failures.
- [Anomaly Detection from Telemetry](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-detection-telemetry): Catching the fault you did not enumerate - unsupervised detection of behavior the plant has never shown before.
- [Disruption Precursors in the Breeder](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-disruption-precursors): For Hyperion, the anomaly ensemble specializes in the magnetic and kinetic signatures that precede a tokamak disruption, feeding disruption avoidance.
- [Quench & Disruption Precursor Features](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-precursor-features): Sub-threshold signatures engineered from magnetics, strain, and profile telemetry give the anomaly ensembles a head start on quench and disruption.
- [Quantifying Precursor Lead Time](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-precursor-lead-time): The value of a precursor detector is the lead time it buys; Kronos measures lead-time distributions and designs actuation around the time available.
- [Anomaly and Precursor Timeline UX](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-precursor-timeline-ux): A shared timeline that shows precursors emerging, growing, and resolving — turning the anomaly ensembles' outputs into a story an operator can read.
- [Detecting Sub-Threshold Magnet-Quench Precursors](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-quench-precursors): Kronos's anomaly ensemble catches the earliest signs of a REBCO magnet quench, below the threshold that would trip protection, so the twin can act before a trip is forced.
- [Sub-Threshold Alarming and False-Alarm Control](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anomaly-subthreshold-thresholds): Detecting precursors below protection thresholds only helps if the alarm rate is low enough to act on; Kronos tunes thresholds against a cost of false vs missed alarms.
- [Anti-Windup · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anti-windup): Anti-windup schemes prevent an integrator from accumulating error while the actuator is saturated, avoiding large overshoot and sluggish recovery.
- [Anyon Braiding and Logical Gates · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anyon-braiding-logical-gates): Moving code excitations around one another and around code boundaries implements logical operations, the picture behind braiding and code deformation.
- [Anyons and Topological Order · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/anyons-and-topological-order): Excitations of topological codes behave as anyons whose braiding statistics underlie both the robustness of the code and its logical operations.
- [Apache Arrow In-Memory Format · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/apache-arrow-in-memory): Apache Arrow defines a standard columnar layout in memory so systems share data without serialization, and process it with vectorized speed.
- [Authentication, Authorization, and Zero-Trust Boundary](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/api-authn-authz): Mutual TLS proves who is calling, scoped RBAC decides what they may do, and every external actor is treated as untrusted until cryptographically identified.
- [API Contract, Schemas, and Versioning](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/api-contract-and-schemas): Every external message is a validated, versioned document; the contract is the durable interface that lets the plant evolve without breaking the parties bound to it.
- [APIs and Interfaces · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/apis-and-interfaces): An interface is a contract between parts of a system; honoring it lets pieces built by different people, at different times, work together.

- [Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/approximate-nearest-neighbor-search): ANN algorithms find vectors close to a query far faster than exhaustive comparison by accepting a small, tunable loss in recall.
- [Approximation Algorithms · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/approximation-algorithms): An approximation algorithm runs in polynomial time and returns a solution provably close to optimal for a hard optimization problem.
- [Arbitrary Waveform Generators · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/arbitrary-waveform-generators): Arbitrary waveform generators synthesize the precisely shaped pulses that drive qubit gates, one of the workhorses of quantum control.

- [ARIMA Models · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/arima-models): ARIMA forecasts a series by combining autoregression, differencing for trend, and a moving average of past errors.
- [Arithmetic Intensity · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/arithmetic-intensity): Arithmetic intensity is the ratio of arithmetic operations performed to bytes moved from memory, and it decides whether a kernel is memory- or compute-bound.
- [The Arnoldi Iteration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/arnoldi-iteration): A Krylov method that reduces a large nonsymmetric matrix to a small upper-Hessenberg form, giving eigenvalues and underpinning GMRES.
- [Arrays · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/arrays): An array stores a fixed number of equal-size elements in one contiguous block, giving constant-time access by index.
- [Artificial Intelligence · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/artificial-intelligence): The field of building systems that perform tasks normally requiring human intelligence, from perception to reasoning and control.
- [Reconciling Models with the As-Built Machine · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/as-built-model-reconciliation): Hardware never matches the drawing exactly; measuring the real machine and updating the models keeps the digital twin honest.
- [ASCII · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ascii): ASCII is a 7-bit character code mapping 128 values to letters, digits, punctuation, and control codes.

- [The Crank-Nicolson Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/crank-nicolson-method): Crank-Nicolson averages explicit and implicit steps to solve parabolic PDEs with second-order accuracy in time and unconditional stability.

- [Real-Time Equilibrium Reconstruction · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/equilibrium-reconstruction-real-time): Equilibrium reconstruction infers the plasma&#x27;s magnetic shape and internal profiles from external measurements, fast enough to feed control.

- [Fixed-Point Grover Search · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fixed-point-grover-search): A variant of Grover search that converges monotonically to the target, eliminating the risk of overshooting the solution.
- [Fixed-Point Iteration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fixed-point-iteration): Rewriting f(x)=0 as x=g(x) and iterating x_{n+1}=g(x_n) converges to a fixed point whenever g is a contraction near the root.

- [Flag Fault-Tolerant Syndrome Extraction · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/flag-fault-tolerant-syndrome-extraction): Flag-based syndrome extraction schedules a few ancilla qubits so that any harmful measurement fault is detected, keeping the effective distance intact.

- [Job Scheduling and Batch Systems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-job-scheduling): Batch schedulers allocate a shared cluster&#x27;s nodes among many users&#x27; jobs, balancing throughput, fairness, and utilization.

- [The Memory Hierarchy · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-memory-hierarchy): Memory is organized as a hierarchy from fast, small registers to slow, large storage, and performance depends on keeping data close to the processor.

- [MPI Collective Operations · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-mpi-collectives): Collectives are group communications, such as broadcast, reduce, and all-to-all, that libraries implement with efficient algorithms across all ranks.

- [Network Topologies · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-network-topologies): Topology is the arrangement of links between nodes; it determines message hop counts, bisection bandwidth, and how a cluster scales.
- [NUMA: Non-Uniform Memory Access · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-numa): On multi-socket nodes, memory local to a core is faster than remote memory; ignoring this non-uniformity silently halves performance.
- [Numerical Precision on Hardware · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-numerical-precision): Floating-point formats trade range, accuracy, speed, and memory; choosing the right precision is central to fast and correct computation.

- [SIMD and Vectorization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-simd-vectorization): SIMD applies one instruction to several data elements at once; vectorization is the art of shaping code so the compiler or CPU can use it.

- [Task Parallelism · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-task-parallelism): Task parallelism runs different operations on different processors, coordinating them through dependencies rather than a single shared loop.
- [Tensor and Matrix Cores · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-tensor-cores): Tensor cores are hardware units that multiply small matrices in one operation, delivering most of an accelerator&#x27;s throughput on deep learning.
- [Threads versus Processes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-thread-vs-process): Threads share one address space within a process; processes have separate memory. The distinction shapes communication, isolation, and cost.
- [Weak Scaling · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hpc-weak-scaling): Weak scaling grows the problem size in proportion to the processor count, testing whether a code can tackle larger problems in constant time.

- [Maximum-Likelihood Decoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/maximum-likelihood-decoding): The optimal decoder picks the logical class with the highest total probability, correcting the equivalence class of errors rather than one error.

- [The Maxwell-Boltzmann Distribution · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/maxwell-boltzmann-distribution): The equilibrium velocity distribution of a plasma species, from which reactivities and rates are computed.
- [Maxwell's Equations in Plasmas · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/maxwell-equations-plasma): The four field equations that, coupled to charged-particle motion, govern all electromagnetic behavior of a plasma.
- [Monte Carlo Dropout · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mc-dropout): Monte Carlo dropout estimates uncertainty by keeping dropout active at prediction time and sampling many stochastic forward passes.
- [MCNP-Class Radiation Transport · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mcnp-class-transport): MCNP-class codes are established general-purpose Monte-Carlo transport tools, long used as reference standards for neutronics, shielding, and dosimetry.
- [Monte Carlo Tree Search · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mcts-fundamentals): MCTS builds an asymmetric search tree by repeated simulation, focusing effort on the most promising moves.
- [Mealy Machine · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mealy-machine): In a Mealy machine the outputs depend on both the current state and the current inputs, reacting faster but risking glitches.
- [Measurement and Observable Estimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-and-observable-estimation): Extracting physical quantities from a simulated quantum state efficiently, often the hidden bottleneck of quantum simulation.
- [Measurement-Based Quantum Computing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-based-computing): In the one-way model, computation proceeds by measuring qubits of a pre-built entangled cluster state, not by applying gates.
- [Measurement Error Mitigation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-error-mitigation): Correcting readout errors by characterizing and inverting the confusion between prepared and measured bitstrings.
- [Measurement Errors and Repeated Measurement · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-errors-and-repeated-measurement): Because syndrome measurements are themselves noisy, codes repeat them and decode over space and time to distinguish real errors from false readings.
- [Measurement-Induced Dephasing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-induced-dephasing): Photons in a readout resonator carry qubit information; the same information leak dephases the qubit whenever the resonator population fluctuates.
- [Observables and Hermitian Operators · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-observables): Observables are represented by Hermitian operators, whose real eigenvalues are the possible measurement outcomes and whose eigenvectors are the outcome states.
- [Measurement Tools in the Model · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/measurement-tools-in-the-model): Point-to-point, radial, and layer-thickness measurement tools let you read true dimensions directly off the geometry.
- [Medallion Architecture · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/medallion-architecture): The medallion architecture organizes a data lake into bronze, silver, and gold layers, refining raw data into curated, consumption-ready tables in stages.
- [Meet in the Middle · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/meet-in-the-middle): A technique that halves the exponent of brute force by splitting the search, solving both halves, and combining results.
- [Memoization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memoization): Memoization caches the results of function calls so repeated calls with the same arguments return instantly instead of recomputing.
- [Memory-Augmented Neural Networks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memory-augmented-networks): Memory-augmented networks pair a controller with an external, addressable memory it can read from and write to, separating computation from storage.
- [Memory Consistency Models · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memory-consistency-models): A memory consistency model defines the order in which one core&#x27;s memory operations become visible to others in a shared-memory system.
- [Memory Controllers · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memory-controllers): A memory controller translates a processor&#x27;s memory requests into the precise timed command sequences that DRAM chips require.
- [Memory Hierarchy · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memory-hierarchy): The memory hierarchy stacks storage from small and fast to large and slow, using locality to give the illusion of both.
- [Memory Locking and Cache Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memory-locking-and-cache-control): Page faults and cache misses cause unpredictable delays; locking memory and controlling cache behavior are standard techniques for real-time determinism.
- [The Memory Wall · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memory-wall): The memory wall is the widening gap between how fast processors compute and how fast memory can supply data to them.
- [The Mercier Criterion · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mercier-criterion): The local stability condition against pressure-driven interchange modes on a single flux surface.
- [Merge Sort · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/merge-sort): Merge sort splits the array in half, sorts each recursively, and merges the two sorted halves, guaranteeing O(n log n) and stability.
- [The Mermin-Peres Magic Square · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mermin-peres-magic-square): A three-by-three grid of two-qubit observables gives a compact, state-independent proof of quantum contextuality.
- [Mesh Adaptation and Error Estimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mesh-adaptation-error-estimation): Error estimators measure where a discrete solution is least accurate, driving adaptation that puts resolution where it reduces error most.
- [Mesh Generation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mesh-generation): Mesh generation partitions a geometry into elements or cells on which a discretization is built, balancing fidelity, quality, and count.
- [Mesh Generation for Fusion Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mesh-generation-for-fusion): Mesh generation builds the computational grids fusion codes solve on, aligning them to magnetic geometry while handling singular features like the X-point.
- [Mesh Quality and Resolution · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mesh-quality-and-resolution): The discretization mesh shapes the solution&#x27;s accuracy; poor quality or resolution corrupts results before any equation is solved.
- [Mesh Quality Metrics · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mesh-quality-metrics): Mesh quality metrics quantify how well-shaped and well-sized elements are, since distorted cells degrade accuracy and solver conditioning.
- [Mesh Simplification and Decimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mesh-simplification-decimation): Reducing a mesh&#x27;s triangle count while preserving its shape keeps 3D models interactive and enables level-of-detail rendering.
- [Message Passing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/message-passing): Message passing is the unifying recipe of graph neural networks: gather from neighbors, aggregate symmetrically, then update each node.
- [Message-Passing Neural Networks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/message-passing-neural-networks): The message-passing framework describes most graph neural networks as three steps: compute messages on edges, aggregate them at nodes, and update node states.
- [Message Queues · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/message-queues): A message queue decouples producers from consumers by buffering messages, absorbing load spikes and letting components fail and recover independently.
- [Message Queues and Brokers · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/message-queues-and-brokers): A message broker decouples producers from consumers by durably buffering and routing records, absorbing bursts and surviving failures.
- [Meta-Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/meta-reinforcement-learning): Meta-RL learns how to learn, producing agents that adapt to a new task within a handful of episodes.
- [Metadata and Data Catalogs · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metadata-and-cataloging): Metadata is data about data; a catalog makes datasets discoverable by recording what they are, where they live, and how they relate.
- [Metadata Governance](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metadata-governance): Strict governance ensures every datum carries correct, complete metadata — machine, channel, calibration, quality, version — so nothing is orphaned.
- [Metastability · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metastability): Metastability is the unstable, undefined state a flip-flop can enter when its timing rules are violated, resolving only after an unpredictable delay.
- [The Method of Lines · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/method-of-lines): The method of lines discretizes space first, converting a PDE into a large system of ODEs to be integrated in time by any suitable solver.
- [Metric Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metric-learning): Metric learning trains an embedding where distance reflects semantic similarity, enabling retrieval and verification.

- [Sampling with Metropolis-Hastings · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metropolis-hastings-sampling): Draw samples from a distribution you can only evaluate up to a constant, using a random walk with an accept-reject rule.
- [The MHD Energy Principle · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mhd-energy-principle): A variational test for ideal stability: an equilibrium is stable if every allowed displacement raises the potential energy.
- [MHD Equilibrium and Force Balance · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mhd-equilibrium-force-balance): The static balance grad p = J x B that every confined plasma must satisfy at each instant.
- [The Linear MHD Stability Eigenproblem](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mhd-linear-stability-eigenproblem): Linearizing ideal MHD about an equilibrium gives a self-adjoint force operator whose eigenvalues are growth rates; the AI learns its unstable manifold.

- [Monte Carlo for Uncertainty Quantification · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/monte-carlo-uq): Monte Carlo estimates output statistics by random sampling of inputs, a robust dimension-independent workhorse of uncertainty propagation.
- [Monte Carlo Variance Reduction](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/monte-carlo-variance-reduction): Weight windows, importance biasing, and splitting that let Kronos resolve deep-shield and rare-channel quantities without brute force.
- [Moore Machine · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/moore-machine): In a Moore machine the outputs depend only on the current state, giving glitch-free outputs synchronized to the clock.
- [The Morris Screening Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/morris-method): The Morris method screens many inputs with few runs, flagging which are negligible, which are linear, and which are nonlinear or interacting.
- [Morris Screening · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/morris-screening): A cheap global method that separates influential inputs from negligible ones before spending a full sensitivity budget.
- [Mo's Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mos-algorithm): Answering many offline range queries efficiently by reordering them to minimize the movement of two pointers.
- [Moving-Horizon Estimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/moving-horizon-estimation): MHE estimates states by solving a constrained optimization over a sliding window of recent measurements, the estimation dual of predictive control.

- [MPC Constraints and the KKT Conditions](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-constraints-kkt): Hard operating limits enter MPC as inequality constraints; the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions define the optimum and expose which limits are active.
- [MPC for DEC Voltage and Grid Synchronization](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-dec-voltage-control): The burner's direct energy conversion produces electrical output that must track collector potentials and synchronize to the grid; Kronos governs this with MPC.

- [The Linear-Quadratic Regulator Baseline](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-linear-quadratic-regulator): LQR is the unconstrained closed-form limit of MPC; its Riccati solution is the baseline gain and the terminal cost that makes MPC provably stable.
- [One MPC Optimization Step · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-one-step): Solve a single model-predictive-control problem: minimize a quadratic cost over a short horizon, apply only the first control, then repeat.

- [MPC QP Solver Mathematics](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-qp-solver-mathematics): A linear-model MPC step is a quadratic program; solving it fast and reliably each cycle is what makes real-time predictive control feasible.
- [Receding Horizon and Real-Time Feasibility](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-receding-horizon): MPC re-solves every cycle; Kronos chooses horizon length and solver so the plan is both far-sighted enough and fast enough for the control cadence.
- [Receding Horizon, Terminal Cost, and Stability](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-receding-horizon-stability): A finite-horizon planner can be unstable unless a terminal cost and terminal set are chosen correctly; this is what makes MPC provably safe to run in a loop.
- [The Certified Safe Operating Envelope](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-safe-operating-envelope): MPC never optimizes freely; it optimizes inside a certified envelope of states and actuator moves proven safe, which is the constraint set X_safe.
- [Surrogate Models Inside the MPC Loop](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-surrogate-in-loop): MPC needs to roll the plant model forward many times per cycle, so Kronos uses fast differentiable surrogates as the prediction model.
- [Terminal Sets and Recursive Feasibility](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-terminal-set-stability): The theory that lets Kronos trust MPC over a finite horizon to keep the machine safe indefinitely: a terminal safe set and a terminal cost.
- [MPC to FPGA Command Handoff](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-to-fpga-command-handoff): L3's model-predictive control produces optimized trajectories; L1 validates and executes them, so the intelligent target is realized within hard timing.
- [Message Passing Interface · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi): The standard programming model for communication between processes in distributed-memory parallel computing.
- [MPI Allreduce · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-allreduce): Allreduce combines a value from every process using a reduction operator and delivers the identical result back to all processes.
- [MPI All-to-All · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-alltoall): All-to-all is the total exchange in which every process sends a distinct message to every other process, transposing data across the group.
- [Barrier Synchronization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-barrier-sync): A barrier blocks every process until all processes in the communicator have reached it, giving a common synchronization point.
- [MPI Broadcast · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-broadcast): Broadcast sends one process&#x27;s data to every other process in the communicator in a single coordinated operation.
- [MPI Collective Communication · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-collectives-overview): Collectives are group communication operations in which every process in a communicator participates in a single coordinated data movement.
- [MPI Reduce · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-reduce): Reduce combines a value from every process using an operator and delivers the single result to one root process.
- [MPI Scatter and Gather · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-scatter-gather): Scatter distributes distinct chunks of a root&#x27;s array to each process; gather is its inverse, collecting each process&#x27;s piece back to the root.
- [MPI Shared-Memory Windows · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi-shared-memory): MPI-3 lets processes on the same node allocate a shared-memory window they can access with ordinary load and store instructions.
- [Model-Reference Adaptive Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mrac): MRAC adjusts controller parameters online so the closed loop matches a chosen reference model despite plant uncertainty.
- [MTBF, MTTR and Spares](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mtbf-mttr-and-spares): The reliability and repair statistics that feed every availability model, and how spares provisioning cuts effective repair time.
- [mu-Synthesis · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mu-synthesis): mu-synthesis designs controllers that are robust against structured uncertainty by minimizing the structured singular value of the closed loop.
- [Multi-Agent Consensus · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/multi-agent-consensus): Consensus protocols drive a network of agents to agree on a common value using only communication with neighbors.
- [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/multi-agent-rl): When many learning agents share an environment, each faces a moving target: the others are learning too.
- [Multi-Armed Bandits · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/multi-armed-bandits): Bandit algorithms balance exploring uncertain options against exploiting the best-known one to maximize cumulative reward.
- [Multi-Controlled X Gate (MCX) · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/multi-controlled-x-gate): Flips a target qubit only when every one of several control qubits is set, the multi-input generalization of CNOT and Toffoli.
- [Multi-Factor Authentication · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/multi-factor-authentication): Requiring two or more independent proofs of identity so that stealing any single credential is not enough to gain access.
