- [Offline Batch RL from Logged Pulses](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-batch-rl): Control policies are learned from the logged L0 pulse archive using conservative offline RL, never by exploring on the live machine, where exploration is a fault.
- [Supercomputing for Offline Multi-Physics Monte Carlo](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-monte-carlo-supercomputing): The largest recurring L0 workload: billions of particle histories tracing neutron transport, breeding, and damage through both machines.
- [Why Offline Compute Is Separated from Real-Time](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-realtime-separation): The architectural decision to keep heavy, non-deterministic foundation compute strictly apart from the microsecond control plane.
- [Offline Retraining on L0](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-retraining-on-l0): L0 is where every model is retrained: a slow, expansive, reproducible compute substrate that regenerates ground truth before any artifact is compiled toward the machine.
- [Offline RL: Conservative Q-Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-rl-cql): CQL learns from a fixed dataset by pushing down Q-values on unseen actions, preventing overestimation of out-of-distribution behavior.
- [Offline RL: Implicit Q-Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-rl-iql): IQL learns entirely within the dataset by never evaluating actions it has not seen, using expectile regression on the value function.
- [Offline-to-Online RL · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/offline-to-online-rl): Pretrain a policy on logged data, then fine-tune it with limited online interaction, combining safety and adaptability.
- [The Generalized Ohm's Law · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ohms-law-generalized): The electron momentum balance that connects electric field, current, and the two-fluid and Hall terms.
- [OLAP vs OLTP · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/olap-vs-oltp): OLTP systems run many small transactions on current records; OLAP systems run few large scans that aggregate history. Their designs pull in opposite directions.
- [One Architecture, Two Machines](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/one-architecture-two-machines): The same eight-layer stack runs the breeder tokamak and the burner tandem mirror; only the physics the top layers reason about changes.
- [One-Class SVM · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/one-class-svm): A one-class SVM learns a boundary that encloses normal data, treating outside points as anomalies.
- [One-Hot Encoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/one-hot-encoding): Representing a categorical value as a binary vector with a single active element.
- [The One-Kelvin Pot and Condensing Stage · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/one-kelvin-pot): The condensing stage cools and liquefies the incoming helium-3 stream before it enters the heat exchangers, historically done by a pumped one-kelvin pot.
- [One-Sided (RMA) Communication · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/one-sided-rma): One-sided communication lets a process read or write a remote process&#x27;s memory directly, without the remote process issuing a matching call.
- [One's Complement · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ones-complement): One&#x27;s complement represents a negative number by inverting all the bits of its positive form.
- [Ontologies and Controlled Vocabularies · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ontologies-and-controlled-vocabularies): Controlled vocabularies fix the terms used to describe data; ontologies add the relationships among those terms so machines can reason.
- [Open Loop vs Closed Loop · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/open-loop-vs-closed-loop): Open-loop control commands blindly; closed-loop control measures the result and corrects, buying disturbance rejection and robustness.
- [The Open Published Data Record · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/open-published-data-record): An open data record deposits the data behind published results in a persistent archive so others can inspect, verify, and reuse it.
- [Open Reproducible Science as a Credibility Strategy · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/open-reproducible-science-credibility): Publishing methods, data, and code so others can reproduce results is how Kronos earns trust in claims that cannot yet be shown on hardware.
- [Open Science and Preregistration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/open-science-and-preregistration): Making methods, data, and intentions public before results are known guards against selective reporting and lets others check the work.
- [Open Science and the Published Record · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/open-science-and-published-record): Publishing methods, data, and code turns private claims into a record others can check, cite, and extend.
- [OpenMC and Open-Source Neutronics · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/openmc-overview): OpenMC is an open-source Monte-Carlo particle transport code widely used for fusion neutronics, with a scriptable interface and modern geometry support.
- [Operating Narrative: Cold Start](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operating-narrative-cold-start): A plain sequence from a fully cold machine to first plasma, and every point where the stack can hold, abort, or safe the plant.
- [Operations Copilot: Commissioning and First-Campaign Support](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operations-copilot-commissioning-support): Generating and sequencing the commissioning procedures that take the breeder from construction start (Q2 2027) toward FOAK first tritium (~2030).
- [The Operations Copilot: Scope and Reasoning Loop](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operations-copilot-overview): An advisory agent that generates runbooks and procedures, supports shift handoff, and assembles campaign context from the twin and the data fabric.
- [Operations Copilot: Procedure Generation](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operations-copilot-procedure-generation): Generating startup, shutdown, recovery, and maintenance procedures from approved templates, twin state, and retrieved standing orders.
- [Operations Copilot: Runbook Generation](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operations-copilot-runbook-generation): Assembling an approved scenario into an ordered, precondition-checked runbook where each side-effecting step routes through L4 and human confirmation.
- [Operations Copilot: Shift Handoff and Campaign Context](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operations-copilot-shift-handoff): Summarizing machine state, open items, and outstanding risks between crews with citations, so context is not lost across a handoff.
- [Operator Abort and Manual Trip](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-abort-and-manual-trip): A human can always take the machine to safe state through a path that does not route through the AI, the network, or ordinary software.
- [Operator Learning and Fourier Neural Operators · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-learning-fno-plasma): Operator-learning methods approximate the solution operators of plasma partial differential equations, generalizing across inputs and resolutions.
- [Operator Learning Theory · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-learning-theory): Operator learning studies when and how mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces can be approximated and generalized from data.
- [Operator Quantum Error Correction · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-quantum-error-correction): The operator, or subsystem, framework generalizes the standard correction conditions to allow part of the encoded space to be discarded rather than protected.
- [Operator Situational Awareness](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-situational-awareness): Designing displays around Endsley's three levels — perception, comprehension, and projection — so operators of both machines always know what is, what it means, and what comes next
- [Operator Splitting · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-splitting): Operator splitting advances a multi-physics problem by solving its constituent operators in sequence, each with a method suited to it.
- [Operator Training Simulators · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-training-simulator): A twin-based training simulator lets operators practice normal, off-normal, and emergency operations on a faithful virtual machine.
- [Operator Training Simulators · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/operator-training-simulators): High-fidelity plant simulators that let operators build skill and rehearse rare events safely before the plant exists.
- [Adadelta · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-adadelta): Adadelta extends Adagrad with a decaying gradient average and a matching decaying average of updates, removing the need to choose a global learning rate.
- [Adagrad · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-adagrad): Adagrad gives each parameter its own learning rate, shrinking it in proportion to the accumulated size of that parameter&#x27;s past gradients.
- [Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-admm): ADMM splits a large problem into smaller pieces coupled by a linear constraint, then coordinates their solutions through a dual variable.
- [Bandit Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-bandit-optimization): Bandit optimization chooses actions to minimize loss when only the chosen action&#x27;s outcome is observed, forcing a trade-off between exploration and exploitation.
- [Block Coordinate Descent · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-block-coordinate-descent): Block coordinate descent updates a group of correlated variables jointly at each step, restoring efficiency when single-coordinate updates stall.
- [Branch and Bound · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-branch-and-bound): Branch and bound solves hard discrete problems by recursively splitting the search space and pruning branches that cannot beat the best solution found.
- [Branch and Cut · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-branch-and-cut): Branch and cut combines branch-and-bound search with cutting planes that tighten the relaxation at each node, the core of modern MIP solvers.
- [CMA-ES · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-cma-es): The covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy samples candidates from a Gaussian and reshapes that Gaussian toward better regions, needing no gradients.
- [Condition Number in Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-condition-number-optimization): The condition number, the ratio of largest to smallest curvature, predicts how slowly gradient methods converge and why preconditioning helps.
- [Coordinate Descent · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-coordinate-descent): Coordinate descent optimizes one variable at a time, holding the rest fixed, and cycles or samples through the coordinates until convergence.
- [Cutting-Plane Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-cutting-plane-methods): Cutting-plane methods build an outer polyhedral approximation of a convex problem, adding one linear inequality at a time to trim the search region.
- [Derivative-Free Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-derivative-free-optimization): Derivative-free optimization minimizes functions using only their values, essential when gradients are unavailable, unreliable, noisy, or expensive.
- [Distributionally Robust Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-distributionally-robust-optimization): Distributionally robust optimization hedges against uncertainty in the probability distribution itself, optimizing the worst case over a set of plausible distributions.
- [The Frank-Wolfe Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-frank-wolfe): Frank-Wolfe minimizes a smooth function over a convex set using only linear subproblems, never projecting back onto the set.
- [The Hessian and Curvature · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-hessian-and-curvature): The Hessian matrix of second derivatives describes an objective&#x27;s local curvature, classifying critical points and governing how fast optimizers converge.
- [Integer Programming · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-integer-programming): Integer programming optimizes a linear objective over linear constraints where some or all variables must take whole-number values.
- [Kelley's Cutting-Plane Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-kelley-cutting-plane): Kelley&#x27;s method minimizes a convex function by building a lower model from its supporting linear pieces and minimizing that model each round.
- [Learning-Rate-Free Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-learning-rate-free-methods): Learning-rate-free methods aim to match a well-tuned step size automatically, removing the most fragile hyperparameter of gradient-based optimization.
- [Line Search · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-line-search): Line search chooses how far to move along a descent direction each iteration, turning a direction into a concrete, safely sized step.
- [Loss Landscape Geometry · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-loss-landscape-geometry): The geometry of a model&#x27;s loss surface, its valleys, barriers, and flatness, shapes how training proceeds and how well the result generalizes.
- [LP Relaxation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-lp-relaxation): The LP relaxation drops integrality from an integer program, yielding a tractable linear program whose optimum bounds the true integer optimum.
- [Mirror Descent · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-mirror-descent): Mirror descent generalizes gradient descent by measuring distance with a problem-adapted geometry instead of the Euclidean norm.
- [Mixed-Integer Programming · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-mixed-integer-programming): Mixed-integer programming combines continuous and integer variables, letting a single model capture both discrete decisions and continuous quantities.
- [The Multi-Armed Bandit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-multi-armed-bandit): The multi-armed bandit is the simplest model of learning by trial and error: repeatedly pull one of several arms with unknown reward, aiming to maximize total reward.
- [Natural Gradient · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-natural-gradient): The natural gradient rescales the ordinary gradient by the Fisher information matrix, following the steepest descent direction in distribution space.
- [The Nelder-Mead Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-nelder-mead): The Nelder-Mead simplex method minimizes a function by moving and reshaping a geometric simplex of points, using only function values.
- [Nonconvex Optimization Landscapes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-nonconvex-landscapes): Nonconvex objectives have multiple minima, saddles, and plateaus, so no method guarantees a global optimum, yet local methods often work well in practice.
- [Online Convex Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-online-convex-optimization): Online convex optimization makes a sequence of decisions against an adversary revealing convex losses one at a time, judged by regret against the best fixed choice.
- [Powell's Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-powells-method): Powell&#x27;s method minimizes a function by successive line searches along a set of directions that it updates to become mutually conjugate, without derivatives.
- [Proximal Gradient Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-proximal-gradient): Proximal gradient descent minimizes a smooth term plus a nonsmooth term by taking a gradient step, then a proximal step.
- [The Proximal Operator · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-proximal-operator): The proximal operator generalizes projection: it finds the point that balances staying near a target against reducing a possibly nonsmooth function.
- [Regret Minimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-regret-minimization): Regret measures how much worse a sequence of decisions did than the best fixed choice in hindsight; minimizing it is the goal of online learning.
- [RMSprop for Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-rmsprop): RMSprop adapts per-parameter learning rates using an exponentially decaying average of squared gradients, curing Adagrad&#x27;s vanishing step size.
- [Robust Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-robust-optimization): Robust optimization guards against uncertain data by optimizing for the worst case within a defined uncertainty set, requiring no probability distribution.
- [Saddle Points · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-saddle-points): Saddle points are critical points that are minima in some directions and maxima in others; they dominate high-dimensional nonconvex landscapes.
- [Sample Average Approximation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-sample-average-approximation): Sample average approximation replaces an intractable expectation with an average over sampled scenarios, converting a stochastic program into a solvable one.
- [SDP Relaxation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-sdp-relaxation): SDP relaxation replaces a hard nonconvex problem with a tractable semidefinite program by lifting variables into a matrix and dropping a rank constraint.
- [Second-Order Cone Programming · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-second-order-cone-programming): Second-order cone programming optimizes a linear objective subject to constraints that a norm is bounded by an affine function, generalizing quadratic programs.
- [Semidefinite Programming · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-semidefinite-programming): Semidefinite programming optimizes a linear objective over symmetric matrices constrained to be positive semidefinite, generalizing linear programming.
- [Stochastic Programming · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-stochastic-programming): Stochastic programming optimizes decisions when some data is random, using probability distributions to model uncertainty and expected outcomes.
- [Subgradient Calculus · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-subgradient-calculus): Rules for computing subdifferentials of sums, maxima, and compositions let algorithms find a valid descent direction even at nondifferentiable points.
- [Subgradient Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-subgradient-methods): Subgradient methods minimize nondifferentiable convex functions by stepping along any subgradient, using a diminishing step size for convergence.
- [Two-Stage Stochastic Programming · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-two-stage-stochastic): The two-stage model makes a here-and-now decision, observes the random outcome, then takes a recourse action to correct for it, minimizing total expected cost.
- [The UCB Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-ucb-algorithm): The upper-confidence-bound algorithm handles the explore-exploit trade-off by playing the arm with the highest optimistic estimate of its reward.
- [Uncertainty Sets · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-uncertainty-sets): The uncertainty set is the modeling choice at the heart of robust optimization; its shape controls both conservatism and computational tractability.
- [The Wolfe Conditions · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/opt-wolfe-conditions): The Wolfe conditions are two inequalities a line-search step must satisfy to guarantee both sufficient decrease and enough curvature progress.
- [Optical Tweezers and Rydberg Blockade · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/optical-tweezers-rydberg): Focused laser beams hold single atoms in place, and the Rydberg blockade turns those atoms into entangling two-qubit gates.
- [Optimal Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/optimal-control): Optimal control finds the input that minimizes a cost functional subject to the system dynamics, unifying many design methods under one principle.
- [Optimization Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/optimization-methods): Optimization finds the inputs that best satisfy an objective under constraints, which is the mathematical core of engineering design.
- [Optimization Under Constraints · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/optimization-under-constraints): A fusion design must be optimized subject to hard limits; the interesting solutions almost always sit on the constraint boundaries.
- [OR Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/or-gate): The OR gate outputs 1 when at least one input is 1, implementing inclusive logical disjunction.
- [Observability & SLOs](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/orchestration-observability-slos): The orchestration layer is measured against explicit service-level objectives for latency, lag, and safety-check availability.
- [Order-of-Accuracy Tests · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/order-of-accuracy-tests): The strongest code-verification check: confirm that the error shrinks at the exact rate the numerical scheme promises.
- [Orthogonal Matrices · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/orthogonal-matrices): Square matrices whose columns are orthonormal; they rotate and reflect without changing lengths or angles.
- [Orthogonality · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/orthogonality): Vectors are orthogonal when their dot product is zero, a condition that simplifies geometry, projection, and computation.
- [Orthonormal Bases · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/orthonormal-bases): A basis of mutually perpendicular unit vectors, in which coordinates are just dot products and geometry is preserved.
- [Osmotic Pressure in Helium Mixtures · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/osmotic-pressure-mixtures): The osmotic pressure of helium-3 dissolved in superfluid helium-4 drives the circulation of a dilution refrigerator and sets its internal flows.
- [OT vs IT Security · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ot-vs-it-security): Operational technology and information technology face different threats, priorities, and constraints, so the same security playbook cannot serve both.
- [Out-of-Distribution Signaling to Operators](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/out-of-distribution-signaling): The single most important trust signal: telling the operator plainly when the machine has entered a regime the AI was never trained on.
- [Out-of-Order Execution · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/out-of-order-execution): Out-of-order execution runs instructions as soon as their inputs are ready rather than in program order, hiding latency.
- [Overfitting · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overfitting): When a model fits the training data&#x27;s noise and fails to generalize to new data.
- [Overfitting and Generalization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overfitting-and-generalization): A model that memorizes its training data fails on new data; the goal is to capture the signal without fitting the noise.
- [Overfitting and Underfitting · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overfitting-underfitting): Overfitting memorizes training noise and fails on new data; underfitting is too simple to capture real structure.
- [The Overhead of Fault Tolerance · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overhead-of-fault-tolerance): Fault tolerance multiplies the number of physical qubits and operations needed, and estimating this overhead is central to planning real machines.
- [Overlapping Communication and Computation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overlap-comm-compute): Overlapping hides communication latency by performing independent computation while messages are in flight rather than waiting for them.
- [The Master Blueprint](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overview): The 8-layer stack, the color grammar and line semantics, and how one architecture runs both machines.
- [P-Values · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/p-values): A p-value is the probability of data at least as extreme as observed, assuming the null hypothesis is true.
- [The P versus NP Question · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/p-vs-np): P versus NP asks whether every problem whose solution can be checked quickly can also be solved quickly.
- [Parallel Computing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parallel-computing): Performing many computations simultaneously by dividing work across multiple processors.
- [Parallel File Systems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parallel-file-systems): Parallel file systems such as Lustre and GPFS spread files across many storage servers so thousands of clients can read and write at once.
- [Parallel-in-Time Integration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parallel-in-time): Parallel-in-time methods extract concurrency from the time direction, iterating across the whole time interval rather than marching strictly sequentially.
- [Parallel I/O · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parallel-io): Parallel I/O lets many processes read and write a shared file concurrently through coordinated interfaces such as MPI-IO and parallel HDF5.
- [Parallelism and Concurrency · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parallelism-and-concurrency): Concurrency is structuring work to overlap; parallelism is running it truly at the same time. Both speed up modern computing.
- [Pareto Fronts · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pareto-fronts): The frontier of non-dominated solutions in objective space, showing the best achievable trade-offs among competing goals.
- [Parity Bit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parity-bit): A parity bit is a single extra bit that makes the number of 1s in a group even or odd for error detection.
- [Parity and Other Fermionic Encodings · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parity-encoding-fermions): Beyond Jordan-Wigner and Bravyi-Kitaev, encodings that trade qubits, locality, and error resilience in different ways.
- [Parity Gates · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parity-gates): Gates that compute or phase according to the parity of a set of qubits, central to error-correction stabilizer checks.
- [Parity Generator and Checker · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parity-generator): A parity circuit adds or checks a single bit that makes the number of ones in a word even or odd, catching single-bit errors.
- [Partial Differential Equations · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/partial-differential-equations): Partial differential equations relate how quantities change across space and time, and they describe nearly all continuum physics.
- [The Partial Trace · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/partial-trace): The partial trace discards a subsystem to yield the correct local description of the part you keep.
- [Particle Filters · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/particle-filter): Particle filters represent any probability distribution with weighted samples, handling nonlinearity and multiple competing hypotheses.
- [The Particle-in-Cell Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/particle-in-cell): Particle-in-cell methods track sample particles moving through continuous fields defined on a grid, coupling kinetic motion to field solves.
- [The Particle-in-Cell Method · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/particle-in-cell-method): The workhorse algorithm that solves the Vlasov-Maxwell system by following sampled particles on a field grid.
- [One Particle-in-Cell Time Step · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/particle-in-cell-step): Walk through the four-phase PIC cycle - deposit, solve, gather, push - that plasma codes repeat millions of times.
- [Particle Swarm Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/particle-swarm-optimization): A swarm of candidate solutions moves through the search space, each pulled toward its own best and the swarm&#x27;s best position.
- [Partitioning and Bucketing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/partitioning-and-bucketing): Partitioning and bucketing physically organize a dataset so queries read less data and joins avoid shuffling, at the cost of careful key choice.
- [Passivity-Based Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/passivity-based-control): Passivity-based control exploits energy conservation and dissipation, ensuring stability because interconnecting passive systems remains passive.
- [Patch Management for Critical Systems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/patch-management-for-critical-systems): Keeping software current closes known vulnerabilities, but on safety-critical systems patching itself carries risk and must be managed carefully.
- [The Pauli Group · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pauli-group): The group generated by the Pauli matrices with phases, the algebraic backbone of stabilizer codes and error correction.

- [Purdue Model Segmentation for the Plant](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/purdue-model-segmentation): The plant network is layered into Purdue levels 0 to 5 with a hardened level 3.5 DMZ, so a breach at one level cannot traverse directly to the physics.
- [Purity and the Trace of rho-Squared · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pure-state-purity): Purity, Tr(rho-squared), measures how pure a quantum state is, ranging from 1 for pure states down to 1 over d for maximally mixed states.
- [Purification of Mixed States · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/purification): Any mixed state can be viewed as part of a larger pure state, a construction that underlies channels, entropy, and open-system reasoning.
- [Purity and Linear Entropy · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/purity-and-linear-entropy): Purity and linear entropy are simple quadratic measures of how far a state is from pure, useful when logarithms are inconvenient.

- [Amplitude Encoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-amplitude-encoding): Amplitude encoding packs a classical vector into the amplitudes of a quantum state, storing 2^n numbers in n qubits but at a steep preparation cost.
- [Angle Encoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-angle-encoding): Angle encoding writes each feature into a qubit rotation angle, giving a shallow, hardware-friendly embedding that dominates near-term quantum machine learning.
- [The Barren Plateau Problem · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-barren-plateaus): In many parameterized quantum circuits the loss gradient shrinks exponentially with qubit count, leaving a nearly flat landscape that gradient descent cannot navigate.
- [Basis Encoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-basis-encoding): Basis encoding stores classical bitstrings directly as computational basis states, the simplest and most transparent way to load discrete data into a circuit.

- [Quantum Circuit Born Machines · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-born-machines): A quantum circuit Born machine is a generative model whose output distribution is the measurement probabilities of a trained parameterized circuit.
- [Classical Simulability and Dequantization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-classical-simulability): Some quantum machine learning methods can be matched by classical algorithms, so a proposed advantage only holds if no efficient classical method exists.
- [Cost Functions and Measurement · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-cost-functions): In quantum machine learning the loss is built from expectation values of observables, and its structure decides both what is learned and whether training is possible.
- [Data Encoding Strategies · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-data-encoding-overview): Getting classical data into a quantum state is a modeling decision with deep consequences for capacity, cost, and whether any speedup survives.
- [Data Re-uploading · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-data-reuploading): Data re-uploading feeds the input into a circuit multiple times, interleaved with trainable layers, letting even a single qubit approximate rich functions.
- [Encoding and Fourier Expressivity · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-encoding-expressivity): A quantum model built by repeated data encoding computes a Fourier series in the input, so the encoding gates decide exactly which functions it can represent.
- [Entangling Layers and Ansatz Design · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-entangling-layers): Entangling layers create correlations between qubits that classical product states cannot represent, and their pattern shapes a circuit&#x27;s power and trainability.

- [Quantum Feature Maps · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-feature-maps): A quantum feature map embeds classical data into a high-dimensional quantum Hilbert space, where linear separations may correspond to nonlinear boundaries in the original space.
- [Quantum Generative Models · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-generative-models): Quantum generative models learn to produce samples from a target distribution using the native randomness of quantum measurement as the sampling engine.
- [The HHL Algorithm and Linear Systems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-hhl): The HHL algorithm solves linear systems on a quantum computer in time logarithmic in the matrix size, under conditions that sharply limit its practical reach.
- [Hybrid Quantum-Classical Training · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-hybrid-training): Near-term quantum machine learning runs a quantum circuit for evaluation and a classical optimizer for parameter updates, looping between the two.
- [The Kernel Trick · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-kernel-trick): The kernel trick lets linear algorithms operate in a high-dimensional feature space using only inner products, never computing the explicit coordinates.
- [Shot Noise and Sampling · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-measurement-shots): Every quantum expectation value is estimated from a finite number of measurements, so shot noise sets the precision and the runtime of quantum machine learning.
- [Near-Term Feasibility and NISQ Constraints · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-near-term-feasibility): Today&#x27;s noisy, intermediate-scale quantum devices limit qubit count, circuit depth, and reliability, which sets hard bounds on what quantum machine learning can do now.
- [Noise, Decoherence, and Error Mitigation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-noise-error): Hardware noise corrupts every quantum computation; error mitigation reduces its effect on expectation values without the full overhead of error correction.
- [Quantum Machine Learning: A Map · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-overview): Quantum machine learning studies how quantum computers might represent, process, and learn from data using superposition, interference, and entanglement.
- [The Parameter-Shift Rule · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-parameter-shift): The parameter-shift rule computes exact gradients of a quantum circuit by evaluating the same circuit at two shifted parameter values.
- [Parameterized Quantum Circuits · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-parameterized-circuits): A parameterized quantum circuit is a fixed gate structure with tunable rotation angles, forming the trainable core of nearly all near-term quantum machine learning.
- [Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-qgan): A quantum GAN pits a quantum generator against a discriminator in a minimax game, training the generator to produce samples the discriminator cannot distinguish from real data.

- [Quantum Advantage in ML: Claims and Caveats · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-quantum-advantage): Quantum advantage in machine learning means solving a learning task better or faster than any classical method, a bar that few results clearly meet.
- [Quantum Boltzmann Machines · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-quantum-boltzmann): A quantum Boltzmann machine is an energy-based generative model whose distribution comes from the thermal state of a quantum Hamiltonian.
- [Quantum Fisher Information and Natural Gradient · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-quantum-fisher): The quantum Fisher information defines the geometry of parameter space, enabling natural-gradient steps that often train quantum models faster than plain gradient descent.
- [Quantum Kernels · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-quantum-kernels): A quantum kernel measures similarity between data points as the overlap of the quantum states they are encoded into, estimated by running a circuit many times.
- [Quantum Neural Networks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-quantum-neural-networks): Quantum neural networks are parameterized quantum circuits trained like neural networks, borrowing the layered structure and gradient-based optimization of deep learning.
- [Quantum Reservoir Computing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-quantum-reservoir): Quantum reservoir computing feeds data into a fixed, untrained quantum system and trains only a simple classical readout on its measured responses.

- [Variational Quantum Classifiers · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qml-variational-classifiers): A variational quantum classifier encodes data into a circuit, applies trainable gates, and measures an observable whose expectation is optimized to predict labels.
- [The QR Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qr-algorithm): The QR algorithm computes all eigenvalues of a matrix by repeated QR factorization, accelerated by Hessenberg reduction and shifts.
- [The QR Algorithm for Eigenvalues · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qr-algorithm-eigenvalues): The standard dense eigenvalue method: repeatedly factor a matrix into orthogonal times triangular, then reverse the product.
- [QR Decomposition · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qr-decomposition): Factoring a matrix into an orthonormal part and an upper triangular part, the stable workhorse for least squares.
- [QR Decomposition via Gram-Schmidt · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qr-gram-schmidt): Orthonormalize the columns of a small matrix with Gram-Schmidt to produce Q and R, and check orthogonality.

- [Quantization and ADC Resolution · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantization-and-adc-resolution): Converting an analog value to a finite number of levels introduces quantization error, and resolution in bits sets the floor on measurement precision.
- [Quantization and Pruning for the Edge](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantization-pruning-edge): Models are shrunk to meet the L1 latency budget through quantization and pruning, with accuracy and calibration re-verified so compression never silently degrades safety.

- [Quantum Amplitude Estimation](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-amplitude-estimation): The primitive behind quadratic Monte Carlo speedups: reading an amplitude to precision eps in O(1/eps) queries instead of O(1/eps^2).
- [Ancilla Qubits and Uncomputation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-ancilla-qubits): Ancilla qubits are helper qubits that hold intermediate results; uncomputation resets them to avoid unwanted entanglement.

- [Quantum Channels · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-channels): A quantum channel is the most general physically allowed transformation of a quantum state, covering ideal gates and all forms of noise.

- [Why Classical Simulation of Quantum Systems Is Hard · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-classical-simulation-limit): Simulating a general quantum system classically needs memory exponential in the number of particles, motivating quantum computers.
- [Coherence as a Resource · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-coherence-resource): Coherence is the presence of definite phase relationships in a superposition; it is the resource consumed by interference and destroyed by noise.

- [Quantum Dots · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-dots): A quantum dot is a nanoscale potential well that confines electrons to discrete levels, an artificial atom used to host spin qubits.

- [Quantum Errors: Bit-Flip and Phase-Flip · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-error-basics): Quantum errors decompose into bit-flips (X), phase-flips (Z), and their combination (Y); correcting these two types suffices for all errors.
- [Quantum Error Correction · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-error-correction): Encoding logical qubits across many physical qubits to detect and correct errors without measuring the data.
- [The Knill-Laflamme Conditions · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-error-correction-conditions): The Knill-Laflamme conditions state exactly when a code can correct a set of errors, unifying all quantum error correction.

- [Quantum Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-gate): A reversible operation that transforms qubit states, the building block of quantum circuits.
- [Quantum Gates as Unitaries · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-gates-unitaries): Every quantum gate is a unitary matrix; circuits are products of these matrices acting on the qubit register.
- [Why Global Phase Is Unobservable · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-global-phase-irrelevance): Multiplying a whole state by a phase changes no measurement outcome, so physical states are rays and global phase is discarded.
- [The Quantum Hamming Bound and Perfect Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-hamming-bound-and-perfect-codes): A counting argument limits how many logical qubits a distance-d code can protect, and codes that meet it with equality are called perfect.
- [NISQ Reality: Near-Term vs Long-Term](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-honest-assessment-nisq): On current noisy devices no fusion computation beats classical; the honest case for quantum is fault-tolerant and years out.
- [Quantum Imaginary-Time Evolution · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-imaginary-time-evolution): Approximating the projection onto a Hamiltonian&#x27;s ground state by simulating evolution in imaginary time.
- [Quantum Simulation and Many-Body Physics · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-information-vs-fusion-modeling): Quantum computers are naturally suited to simulating quantum many-body systems, a class of hard problems relevant to materials and plasma physics.
- [Quantum Instruments · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-instruments): A quantum instrument records a measurement outcome and the conditional state together, the most complete description of measurement.
- [Interference as the Source of Speedups · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-interference): Quantum interference lets amplitude paths add or cancel, concentrating probability on correct answers; it is what makes quantum algorithms fast.
- [Quantum Interference in Detail · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-interference-detail): Interference is the constructive and destructive combination of probability amplitudes, and it is the resource behind quantum speedups.
- [Quantum k-Means Clustering · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-k-means-clustering): Accelerating the assignment step of k-means using quantum distance estimation and amplitude amplification.
- [Quantum LDPC Codes: Overview · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-ldpc-codes-overview): Low-density parity-check quantum codes keep every check and every qubit involved in only a few others, promising high rate with bounded measurement weight.
- [Quantum Linear Algebra · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-linear-algebra): A toolkit of primitives - block encoding, linear combination of unitaries, and singular value transformation - for manipulating matrices as quantum operations.
- [Quantum Linear Systems and the HHL Algorithm](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-linear-systems-hhl): HHL solves linear systems in log dimension in principle, but its fine print makes it a poor fit for Kronos PDE solves; we say why plainly.
- [Quantum Machine Learning: A Skeptical View](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-machine-learning-honest): Quantum machine learning is heavily hyped and thinly proven; Kronos treats it as a research curiosity, not a tool for the digital twin or control.
- [Quantum Measurement and Collapse · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-measurement): Measurement projects a quantum state onto a basis outcome with probability given by the squared amplitude, and the state collapses to that outcome.
- [Choosing a Measurement Basis · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-measurement-bases): Measurement is always relative to a basis; the same state yields different statistics in different bases, and basis choice is a design lever.
- [Quantum Metropolis Sampling · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-metropolis-sampling): A quantum analog of the Metropolis algorithm that samples from the thermal (Gibbs) distribution of a quantum Hamiltonian.
- [Quantum Monte Carlo Integration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-monte-carlo-integration): Estimating expectation values and integrals with a quadratic reduction in sample complexity using amplitude estimation.
- [Amplitude Estimation for Neutronics Monte Carlo](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-monte-carlo-neutronics): Quantum amplitude estimation offers a quadratic speedup for Monte Carlo integrals like neutron transport, useful only far past today's hardware.
- [Quantum Mutual Information · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-mutual-information): Quantum mutual information measures the total correlation, classical and quantum, between two subsystems.
- [No-Deleting and No-Broadcasting Theorems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-no-deleting): Quantum information cannot be deleted against a copy, nor broadcast to independent parties; these complement the no-cloning theorem.
- [Quantum Nondemolition Measurement · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-nondemolition-measurement): A quantum nondemolition measurement extracts information about an observable while leaving that observable&#x27;s value undisturbed, allowing repeated readout.
- [Orthogonality and State Distinguishability · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-orthogonality): Only orthogonal quantum states can be told apart with certainty; non-orthogonal states can never be perfectly distinguished.
- [Quantum Parallelism and Its Limits · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-parallelism): A quantum computer can evaluate a function on a superposition of all inputs at once, but measurement retrieves only one result.
- [Partial Measurement of Multi-Qubit States · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-partial-measurement): Measuring one qubit of an entangled register collapses the whole state consistently, updating the rest without fully determining it.
- [Quantum Phase Estimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-phase-estimation): The canonical algorithm for reading an eigenvalue of a unitary, and thus of a Hamiltonian, from the phase it applies to an eigenstate.
- [Quantum Phase Estimation for Energy Levels](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-phase-estimation-energy-eigenvalues): Phase estimation extracts eigenvalues of a Hamiltonian to arbitrary precision, the fault-tolerant route to chemically accurate fusion-material energies.
- [Quantum Phase Estimation: Worked Example · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-phase-estimation-worked-example): A step-by-step walkthrough estimating the eigenphase of a single-qubit unitary using a small ancilla register.
- [Phase Kickback · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-phase-kickback): Phase kickback transfers a controlled operation&#x27;s eigenphase onto the control qubit, a mechanism behind many quantum algorithms.
- [When Phase Is Measurable · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-phase-measurability): Relative phase between components of a superposition is physically real and measurable; a global phase on the whole state is not.
- [The Plus-Minus Basis · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-plus-minus-basis): The X basis {|+&gt;, |-&gt;} is the diagonal basis conjugate to the computational basis, essential for reading out phase information.
- [Quantum Principal Component Analysis · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-principal-component-analysis): Extracting the dominant eigenvectors of a density matrix by using multiple copies of it as a Hamiltonian.
- [Quantum Process Tomography · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-process-tomography): Process tomography fully reconstructs what an operation does to every input state, giving a complete but expensive picture of a gate.
- [Quantum Reed-Muller Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-reed-muller-codes): Built from classical Reed-Muller codes, this family yields CSS codes with useful transversal non-Clifford gates, at the cost of a low encoding rate.
- [Quantum Registers and Basis Encoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-registers): A quantum register is a collection of qubits treated as one system; basis encoding stores integers as computational basis states.
- [Quantum Resource Estimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-resource-estimation): Forecasting the qubits, gates, and runtime a quantum algorithm needs, the sober accounting that separates promise from readiness.
- [The Kronos Quantum Roadmap](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-roadmap-kronos): A staged, honest plan: benchmark now, invest in fault-tolerant materials simulation later, and treat the He-3 link as the nearest-term reality.
- [Quantum Sensing for Fusion Diagnostics](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-sensing-metrology-diagnostics): Quantum sensors, distinct from quantum computers, offer precision magnetometry and metrology that could sharpen future diagnostics on the Kronos machines.
- [Separable vs Entangled States · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-separable-vs-entangled): Separable states factor into independent parts or classical mixtures of products; entangled states cannot, and are the useful quantum resource.
- [Quantum Shannon Decomposition · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-shannon-decomposition): A recursive method that breaks any n-qubit unitary into two-qubit gates, achieving near-optimal CNOT counts.
- [Quantum Signal Processing · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-signal-processing): Applying a polynomial transformation to the eigenvalues of a block-encoded operator by interleaving it with tunable single-qubit rotations.
- [Quantum Simulation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation): Using a controllable quantum system to model another quantum system that is hard to simulate classically.
- [Quantum Simulation and Fusion Materials · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation-for-fusion-materials): Where quantum simulation could, in the long term, contribute to fusion engineering, stated honestly against current classical practice.
- [Quantum Simulation for Materials · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation-for-materials): Applying quantum simulation to solids and correlated materials, from the Hubbard model to defects, with an honest view of readiness.
- [Why Quantum Systems Are Hard to Simulate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation-hardness): The state of a quantum system grows exponentially with its size, making exact classical simulation infeasible beyond small systems.
- [Quantum Simulation: History and Milestones · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation-history-and-milestones): A timeline of the ideas and experiments that built the field, from Feynman&#x27;s proposal to optimal algorithms and hardware demonstrations.
- [Verifying Quantum Simulations · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation-verification): How to trust the output of a quantum simulator when its regime is, by design, beyond classical checking.
- [Quantum Singular Value Transformation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-singular-value-transformation): A unifying framework that applies polynomial functions to the singular values of a block-encoded matrix.
- [State Preparation and Initialisation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-state-preparation): State preparation resets qubits to a known state and builds the desired input; it is a DiVincenzo criterion and a real error source.
- [Quantum States and State Vectors · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-state-vectors): A pure quantum state is a unit vector in a complex Hilbert space, written as a ket, encoding all predictable information about the system.
- [Quantum Support Vector Machine · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-support-vector-machine): Two distinct approaches to quantum classification: fast kernel evaluation and linear-system-based training.
- [Quantum Supremacy · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-supremacy): The demonstration that a quantum computer performs a task no classical computer can do in feasible time.
- [Quantum Supremacy Experiments · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-supremacy-experiments): Milestone demonstrations that a quantum processor performed a sampling task infeasible for classical supercomputers.
- [The SWAP Test · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-swap-test): The SWAP test uses one ancilla qubit and a controlled-SWAP to estimate the overlap between two unknown quantum states.
- [Quantum Teleportation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-teleportation): Teleportation transfers an unknown qubit state using a shared entangled pair and two classical bits, without moving the qubit itself.
- [The Quantum Teleportation Circuit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-teleportation-circuit): Move an unknown qubit state across a shared Bell pair using two classical bits and local corrections.
- [The Toffoli Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-toffoli-gate): The Toffoli gate is a controlled-controlled-NOT that makes classical logic reversible and is a key primitive in quantum arithmetic.
- [Quantum Transpilation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-transpilation): The full compiler pass that rewrites an abstract circuit into one a specific device can run efficiently.
- [The Uncertainty Principle · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-uncertainty): The uncertainty principle sets a hard lower bound on the product of the spreads of two non-commuting observables.
- [Quantum Volume · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-volume): Quantum volume is a single benchmark that folds together qubit count, connectivity, gate fidelity, and crosstalk into one number.
- [Quantum vs Classical Information · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-vs-classical-information): Quantum information differs from classical in three ways: it cannot be copied, cannot be read without disturbance, and can be entangled.
- [Qubits vs Probabilistic Bits · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-vs-probabilistic-bits): A qubit is not a random classical bit: complex amplitudes, interference, and entanglement set it fundamentally apart.
- [W States · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-w-states): W states are multi-qubit entangled states whose entanglement survives the loss of a qubit, unlike the fragile GHZ states.
- [Quantum Walk Search on Graphs · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-walk-search-on-graphs): Using quantum walks to find marked vertices faster than classical random walks, generalizing Grover search to graph structure.

- [Quasi-Monte Carlo Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quasi-monte-carlo): Quasi-Monte Carlo replaces random samples with low-discrepancy sequences that fill space more evenly, converging faster than plain Monte Carlo.
- [Quasi-Newton Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quasi-newton-methods): Approximate the Hessian from successive gradients, capturing curvature without ever computing second derivatives.
- [Quasilinear Theory · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quasilinear-theory): A weak-turbulence framework in which a spectrum of small waves slowly reshapes the background distribution through velocity-space diffusion.
- [Quasilinear Transport Models · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quasilinear-transport-models): Quasilinear models estimate turbulent transport quickly by combining linear gyrokinetic growth rates with a saturation rule, bridging first-principles codes and transport solvers.
- [Quasiparticle Poisoning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quasiparticle-poisoning): Stray quasiparticles, broken Cooper pairs in a superconductor, degrade qubit coherence and are fought through shielding, gap engineering, and traps.
- [The Qubit · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit): A qubit is the basic unit of quantum information: a two-level quantum system that can hold any superposition of its two basis states.
- [Qubit Calibration Pipelines · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-calibration-pipelines): A calibration pipeline is the ordered set of automated experiments that turn a cold, uncharacterized chip into a device with accurate gates.

- [Microwave Control of Qubits · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-control-microwave): Superconducting and many spin qubits are driven by shaped microwave pulses whose frequency, amplitude, and phase set the rotation on the Bloch sphere.
- [Comparing Qubit-Cooling Requirements · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-cooling-modalities): Different qubit technologies demand very different operating temperatures, from millikelvin for superconductors to room temperature for some photonic and defect-based systems.
- [Qubit Count and the Cooling Curve · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-count-cooling-curve): As processors grow from tens to millions of qubits, the wiring, control, and heat loads scale in ways that push against the limited cooling power of dilution refrigerators.
- [Qubit Error Budgets · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-error-budgets): An error budget accounts for how each physical mechanism contributes to a gate&#x27;s total error, guiding where engineering effort will pay off.
- [Qubit Frequency Allocation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-frequency-allocation): Fixed-frequency processors must assign each qubit a frequency that enables its gates while avoiding collisions with neighbors and defects.
- [Frequency Crowding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-frequency-crowding): As fixed-frequency qubits multiply, their transition frequencies crowd together, causing addressing errors and constraining chip design.
- [The Qubit: Physical Foundations · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qubit-fundamentals): A qubit is any quantum two-level system whose superposition and entanglement encode information a classical bit cannot.

- [Recurrent Neural Networks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/recurrent-neural-networks): RNNs process sequences one step at a time, carrying a hidden state that acts as memory of everything seen so far.

- [Recursion and Recurrences · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/recursion-and-recurrences): Recursive algorithms solve a problem by solving smaller versions of it, and their cost is captured by recurrence relations.

- [Reflex and Supervisory Tier Separation](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reflex-tier-separation): Intelligence proposes on a slow horizon; reflex disposes on a fast one. Keeping these tiers physically separate is what lets the safety case ignore the AI entirely.
- [Register · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/register): A register is a group of flip-flops that stores a multi-bit word and updates all its bits together on a clock edge.
- [Register File Design · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/register-file-design): A register file is a small, fast multi-ported memory holding a processor&#x27;s working registers, read and written every cycle.
- [Register · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/register-glossary): A small, fast storage element inside a processor that holds data being actively worked on.

- [Resistive MHD Stability Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/resistive-mhd-stability-codes): Resistive stability codes admit finite resistivity, allowing reconnection and slow-growing tearing and resistive-wall modes that ideal analysis misses.
- [The Resistive-Wall Mode · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/resistive-wall-mode): A slow external kink that grows on the wall&#x27;s resistive timescale in the gap between the no-wall and ideal-wall limits.
- [Resistive-Wall-Mode Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/resistive-wall-mode-control): Stabilizing slow, wall-limited magnetohydrodynamic modes with feedback coils to allow operation above the no-wall pressure limit.

- [Reward Modeling for Control and Copilots](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reward-modeling-control): The reward model that RLHF optimizes against is itself a versioned, validated artifact — miscalibrated reward is a hazard, so it passes its own gates.

- [RF Full-Wave Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rf-full-wave-codes): Full-wave codes solve the Maxwell wave equation in the plasma directly, capturing interference, mode conversion, and short-wavelength effects ray tracing omits.
- [Richardson Extrapolation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/richardson-extrapolation): Combine solutions on two or three meshes to estimate the exact answer and the discretization error, using the known order of accuracy.

- [Ripple-Carry Adder · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ripple-carry-adder): A ripple-carry adder chains full adders so each carry-out feeds the next stage, giving simple hardware but delay that grows with word width.
- [Ripple Counter · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ripple-counter): A ripple counter chains toggle flip-flops so each stage clocks the next, giving simple hardware but a staggered count.
- [Integrating an ODE with RK4 · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rk4-integrate-ode): Advance a differential equation using the classic fourth-order Runge-Kutta method and see why its error shrinks as the step to the fourth power.
