- [A2C and A3C · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-a2c-a3c): A3C runs many parallel actor-critic workers asynchronously; A2C is its synchronous, simpler variant that often matches it.
- [Actor-Critic Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-actor-critic): Actor-critic methods pair a policy that acts with a value estimator that critiques, combining low-variance updates with direct policy optimization.
- [The Advantage Function · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-advantage-function): The advantage function measures how much better an action is than the policy&#x27;s average, sharpening the learning signal for policy gradients.
- [The Agent-Environment Loop · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-agent-environment-loop): Every reinforcement learning problem is a cycle: observe a state, act, receive reward and next state, repeat.
- [The Bellman Equation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-bellman-equation): The Bellman equation expresses a value as immediate reward plus the discounted value of what follows, making long-horizon value recursive.
- [The Bellman Optimality Equation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-bellman-optimality): The Bellman optimality equation replaces the policy average with a maximum, characterizing the value of acting optimally.
- [Continuous Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-continuous-control): Real-valued action spaces demand methods that output continuous commands rather than choosing from a discrete menu.
- [The Credit Assignment Problem · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-credit-assignment): When reward arrives long after the actions that earned it, the agent must figure out which decisions deserve credit or blame.
- [Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-ddpg): DDPG is an off-policy actor-critic method for continuous control, learning a deterministic policy alongside a Q-function critic.
- [Deep Q-Networks (DQN) · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-deep-q-networks): DQN scales Q-learning to high-dimensional inputs using a neural network, experience replay, and a slowly updated target network.
- [Distributional Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-distributional-rl): Instead of predicting the mean return, distributional RL models the full distribution of possible returns, improving stability and risk awareness.
- [Double Q-Learning and Overestimation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-double-q-learning): The max in Q-learning systematically overestimates values; double Q-learning corrects it by decoupling action selection from evaluation.
- [Dynamic Programming for MDPs · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-dynamic-programming): When the environment model is known, dynamic programming solves an MDP exactly by iterating the Bellman equations over all states.
- [Experience Replay · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-experience-replay): Experience replay stores past transitions and reuses them in random minibatches, breaking correlations and improving sample efficiency.
- [Exploration Strategies in Deep RL · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-exploration-strategies): Beyond random actions, deep RL uses intrinsic curiosity, count bonuses, and posterior sampling to explore hard, sparse-reward tasks.
- [Exploration vs Exploitation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-exploration-vs-exploitation): An agent must balance exploiting what it knows to gain reward now against exploring the unknown to find something better.
- [Function Approximation in RL · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-function-approximation): When states are too many to tabulate, value functions and policies are represented by parameterized functions that generalize across states.
- [Generalized Policy Iteration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-generalized-policy-iteration): Nearly every RL algorithm is a case of two processes — value estimation and policy improvement — pushing toward mutual consistency.
- [A Gridworld Worked Example · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-gridworld-example): A small gridworld makes the abstractions of MDPs, value functions, and value iteration concrete and inspectable.
- [Reinforcement Learning for Heating and Current Drive · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-heating-current-drive): Reinforcement learning discovers policies that command heating and current-drive actuators to reach and hold target plasma states.
- [Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-hierarchical-rl): Hierarchical RL decomposes long tasks into reusable sub-behaviors, letting a high-level policy select among temporally extended options.
- [Imitation Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-imitation-learning): Imitation learning trains a policy to mimic expert demonstrations, bypassing reward design when good examples are available.
- [Inverse Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-inverse-rl): Inverse RL infers the reward function that best explains observed expert behavior, rather than optimizing a given reward.
- [Markov Decision Processes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-markov-decision-process): A Markov decision process formalizes sequential decision making as states, actions, transition probabilities, rewards, and a discount factor.
- [The Markov Property · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-markov-property): A state is Markov when it captures all history relevant to the future, so the past adds nothing once the present is known.
- [Model-Based Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-model-based-rl): Model-based RL learns a model of the environment&#x27;s dynamics and uses it to plan or generate simulated experience.
- [Monte Carlo Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-monte-carlo-methods): Monte Carlo methods learn values from complete episodes by averaging the actual returns that follow each state.
- [Monte Carlo Tree Search · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-monte-carlo-tree-search): Monte Carlo tree search plans by selectively growing a search tree, balancing promising moves against unexplored ones through sampled rollouts.
- [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-multi-agent-rl): When several learning agents share an environment, each faces a moving target as the others adapt, reshaping the learning problem.
- [Multi-Armed Bandits · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-multi-armed-bandits): The multi-armed bandit is the simplest reinforcement learning problem, isolating exploration versus exploitation with no state transitions.
- [Offline Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-offline-rl): Offline RL learns policies entirely from a fixed dataset of logged experience, without any further interaction with the environment.
- [On-Policy vs Off-Policy Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-on-policy-vs-off-policy): On-policy methods learn about the policy they follow; off-policy methods learn about one policy from data generated by another.
- [Partial Observability and POMDPs · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-partial-observability): When the agent cannot observe the full state, it must act on incomplete information and maintain beliefs about what it cannot see.
- [Policies · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-policies): A policy is the agent&#x27;s behavior: a rule, deterministic or stochastic, that maps states to actions.
- [The Policy Gradient Theorem · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-policy-gradient-theorem): The policy gradient theorem gives the gradient of expected return with respect to policy parameters without differentiating the environment.
- [Policy Iteration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-policy-iteration): Policy iteration alternates full policy evaluation with greedy improvement, converging to an optimal policy in a finite number of steps.
- [Proximal Policy Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-ppo): PPO improves policies with a clipped objective that permits several update steps per batch while preventing destructively large policy changes.
- [Q-Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-q-learning): Q-learning is an off-policy temporal-difference method that learns the optimal action-value function regardless of how the agent explores.
- [REINFORCE · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-reinforce): REINFORCE is the simplest policy-gradient algorithm, updating policy parameters using Monte Carlo returns as the action weight.
- [Return and Discounting · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-return-and-discounting): The return is the cumulative reward an agent seeks to maximize; the discount factor sets how much future reward counts against the present.
- [Reward Shaping · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-reward-shaping): Reward shaping adds guidance signals to sparse rewards to speed learning, but poorly designed shaping can change what the agent learns.
- [RL from Human Feedback · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-rlhf): RLHF learns a reward model from human preference judgments, then optimizes a policy against it to align behavior with human intent.
- [Safety in Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-safe-rl): Safe RL seeks policies that respect constraints and avoid harmful behavior during both learning and deployment.
- [Sample Efficiency in RL · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-sample-efficiency): How much interaction an algorithm needs to learn is often the deciding factor when environment steps are slow or costly.
- [SARSA · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-sarsa): SARSA is an on-policy temporal-difference control method that learns the value of the policy it actually follows, including its exploration.
- [Sim-to-Real Transfer · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-sim-to-real): Policies trained in simulation must bridge the reality gap to work on physical systems, using randomization and robust training.
- [Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-soft-actor-critic): SAC is an off-policy actor-critic that maximizes reward plus policy entropy, yielding robust exploration and strong continuous control.
- [States, Actions, and Rewards · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-states-actions-rewards): The three raw ingredients of any reinforcement learning problem: what the agent sees, what it can do, and how it is scored.
- [TD(lambda) and Eligibility Traces · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-td-lambda): TD(lambda) blends one-step temporal-difference learning and Monte Carlo returns using eligibility traces to assign credit over multiple steps.
- [Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3) · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-td3): TD3 fixes DDPG&#x27;s overestimation and instability with twin critics, delayed policy updates, and target smoothing.
- [Temporal-Difference Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-temporal-difference-learning): Temporal-difference learning updates value estimates from one step of experience by bootstrapping off its own next estimate.
- [RL for Tokamak and Plasma Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-tokamak-plasma-control): Deep RL has been applied, in published work, to control the magnetic shape of tokamak plasmas.
- [Trust Region Policy Optimization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-trpo): TRPO improves a policy while limiting how far it moves, using a constraint on policy change to guarantee monotonic improvement.
- [Value Functions · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-value-functions): A value function estimates expected future return, giving the agent a way to compare states and actions without simulating the full future.
- [Value Iteration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-value-iteration): Value iteration solves an MDP by repeatedly applying the Bellman optimality update to every state until the value function stops changing.
- [What Is Reinforcement Learning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rl-what-is-reinforcement-learning): Reinforcement learning trains an agent to choose actions that maximize cumulative reward through trial-and-error interaction with an environment.
- [Preference-Based RL for Control Policies](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rlhf-control-policies): Human preference feedback shapes control-policy behavior where a scalar reward is hard to specify, but only in simulation and only behind the full validation and canary chain.
- [Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rlhf-human-feedback): RLHF trains a reward model from human preference comparisons, then optimizes a policy against it.
- [RLHF for Operator Copilots](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rlhf-operator-copilots): Operator copilots are tuned with reinforcement learning from human feedback so their suggestions match how expert Kronos operators actually reason — never to grant them control.
- [RMSNorm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rmsnorm): RMSNorm normalizes activations by their root-mean-square alone, dropping the mean-centering of layer normalization for a cheaper, equally effective operation.
- [RMSProp · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rmsprop): Fix AdaGrad&#x27;s vanishing step size by scaling gradients with an exponentially decaying average of their recent magnitudes.
- [RMSprop Optimizer · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rmsprop-optimizer): RMSprop scales each parameter&#x27;s step by a running average of its squared gradients, adapting the learning rate per parameter to handle varying gradient magnitudes.
- [Assurance Case (GSN) + Signed Ledger](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-assurance-case-signed-ledger): A structured claims-to-evidence safety argument, and a tamper-evident record of every decision.
- [Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-bayesian-optimal-experimental-design): Plan the fewest, most-informative pulses to validate — accelerate commissioning.
- [Causal Models (do-Calculus)](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-causal-models-do-calculus): Predict interventions correctly, not just correlations.
- [Certified Adversarial Robustness](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-certified-adversarial-robustness): Provable robustness to sensor spoofing and adversarial inputs, beyond network zero-trust.
- [Conformal Prediction](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-conformal-prediction): Distribution-free, finite-sample coverage guarantees on every model prediction.
- [Cross-Machine Disruption Model](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-cross-machine-disruption-model): Transfer-learned disruption prediction from the world's tokamak databases.
- [Explainability & Interpretability](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-explainability-interpretability): Mechanistic explanations operators and regulators can audit — the "why", not just the confidence.

- [Formal Reachability Verification](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-formal-reachability-verification): Prove the closed loop can never reach an unsafe state — over the whole reachable set, not just per step.
- [Independent Verification & Red-Team](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-independent-verification-red-team): A standing third-party replication and adversarial-audit program.
- [Multi-Fidelity Modeling & Data Fusion](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-multi-fidelity-modeling): Combine cheap and expensive simulations for calibrated, affordable accuracy.
- [Neural Lyapunov / ISS Certificates](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-neural-lyapunov-iss-certificates): Learned stability certificates for the coupled twin-plus-controller loop.
- [Neural Operators (DeepONet / FNO)](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-neural-operators): Fast PDE surrogates across the whole parameter space, more general than a single PINN.
- [Neutronics & Activation Twin](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-neutronics-activation-twin): Live displacement damage, helium production, and activation inventory.
- [OOD Detection & Epistemic Gating](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roadmap-ood-detection-epistemic-gating): Detect when the plant is outside the training distribution and defer before acting.

- [Robust Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/robust-control): Robust control guarantees stability and performance despite bounded uncertainty in the plant model, designing for the worst case.
- [Robust Model Predictive Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/robust-mpc): Robust MPC guarantees constraint satisfaction and stability for every disturbance in a bounded set, not just for the nominal prediction.
- [ROC and AUC · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roc-auc): A curve and a summary number describing a classifier&#x27;s performance across all decision thresholds.
- [Role-Based Access Control · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/role-based-access-control): Granting permissions to roles rather than individuals, so access follows job function and is easy to review and revoke.
- [The Role of Benchmarks · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/role-of-benchmarks): Shared reference problems let different methods be compared on equal terms, but only for the narrow thing the benchmark measures.
- [Romberg Integration · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/romberg-integration): Romberg integration applies Richardson extrapolation to the trapezoidal rule, building a table that converges rapidly for smooth integrands.
- [The Roofline Model · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/roofline-model): The roofline model plots achievable performance against arithmetic intensity to show whether a kernel is limited by compute or by memory bandwidth.
- [Root Finding: Overview · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/root-finding-overview): Root finding solves f(x)=0 numerically, choosing among bracketing, open, and hybrid methods that trade guaranteed convergence against speed.
- [Root Locus · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/root-locus): The root locus traces how closed-loop poles move through the s-plane as a single gain is varied from zero to infinity.
- [Rotary Position Embeddings · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rotary-position-embeddings): Rotary position embeddings encode position by rotating query and key vectors, so attention depends on the relative distance between tokens.
- [Round-off Error · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/round-off-error): Finite-precision arithmetic cannot represent most real numbers exactly; the accumulated rounding sets a floor on achievable accuracy.
- [Rounding Modes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rounding-modes): When a result cannot be represented exactly, a rounding mode decides which representable value to pick.
- [The Routh-Hurwitz Criterion · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/routh-hurwitz): Routh-Hurwitz decides stability from the characteristic polynomial&#x27;s coefficients alone, without computing any roots.
- [Real-Time Compute Actuators](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rt-compute-actuators): The bridge from digital command to physical effect is the actuator driver: deterministic RT-compute stages that turn setpoints into coil currents, beam power, and grid voltages.
- [RTOS Scheduling Algorithms · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rtos-scheduling-algorithms): Scheduling decides which task runs when; in real-time systems the algorithm must be analyzable so deadlines can be guaranteed in advance.
- [Rules Engine & Hard Bounds](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rules-engine-hard-bounds): A deterministic rules engine enforces hard operational bounds independently of the ML stack; it can only ever forbid, never command.
- [Run-Length Encoding · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/run-length-encoding): Run-length encoding compresses runs of a repeated value into a single value and a count.
- [Runaway Electron Codes · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runaway-electron-codes): Runaway electron codes model the birth and avalanche of relativistic electrons during disruptions and the schemes that dissipate them safely.
- [Runaway Electron Suppression](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runaway-electron-suppression): A disruption can accelerate a beam of relativistic electrons; the mitigation path is designed to keep that beam from forming or to dissipate it benignly.
- [Runge-Kutta Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runge-kutta): A family of methods for accurately integrating ordinary differential equations step by step.
- [Runge-Kutta Methods · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runge-kutta-methods): Runge-Kutta methods build high-order time integration from several intermediate evaluations of the right-hand side within a single step.
- [Runge-Kutta RK4 · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runge-kutta-rk4): The classic fourth-order Runge-Kutta method combines four slope evaluations per step for high accuracy without needing derivatives of f.
- [Runge's Phenomenon · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runges-phenomenon): High-degree polynomial interpolation on equally spaced nodes oscillates violently near the interval ends, a failure cured by better node placement or splines.
- [The Rutherford Equation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rutherford-equation): The nonlinear equation governing the growth and saturation of magnetic islands from tearing modes.
- [RZX Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rzx-gate): A parametric ZX-interaction gate, the ideal operation realized by the cross-resonance drive and a flexible pulse-efficient primitive.

- [Control and Safety Architecture Overview](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-architecture-overview): Kronos's safety architecture is layered defense: bounded reflex, hardwired interlocks, an ML-independent failsafe, and human oversight, each able to hold the line alone.
- [Safety-Case Replay and Decision Evidence](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-case-replay-evidence): Every trip, override, and gated action is recorded with enough fidelity to replay the event deterministically and prove the safety layers behaved as designed.
- [Safety-Critical Cyber-Physical Design](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-critical-cyber): Cybersecurity and functional safety are co-designed so that no cyber event - however severe - can prevent the machine from reaching a safe state.
- [Safety-Envelope Checks](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-envelope-checks): The envelope checker validates that a command keeps the machine inside a state-dependent safe region, not just under individual scalar limits.
- [The Safety Factor Formula · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-factor-formula): The number of toroidal transits a field line makes per poloidal transit, the master parameter of tokamak stability.
- [The Safety Factor q · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-factor-q): The number of toroidal transits a field line makes per poloidal transit, central to tokamak stability.

- [The Safety Hierarchy and AI](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-hierarchy-and-ai): Safety is layered: deterministic hardware at the floor, bounded control above it, and AI advisory at the top — the higher the intelligence, the less it can harm.
- [Safety-Instrumented System Isolation](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-instrumented-system-isolation): The safety-instrumented system is physically and logically independent of the control network, with a one-way status feed out and no command path in.
- [Safety-Instrumented Systems · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-instrumented-systems): A safety-instrumented system is an independent layer that detects dangerous conditions and forces the process to a safe state, separate from normal control.
- [Safety vs Security Tradeoffs · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/safety-vs-security-tradeoffs): Safety protects people from the system; security protects the system from people. Their measures sometimes pull in opposite directions.
- [Saga & Compensation](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/saga-and-compensation): Long machine procedures cannot hold a single lock; sagas break them into steps each paired with a compensating action that undoes it safely.
- [The Saha Ionization Equation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/saha-equation): The thermodynamic relation giving the ionization balance of a gas in local thermal equilibrium.
- [Saliency Maps · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/saliency-maps): Saliency maps highlight which parts of an input a neural network relied on, usually via gradients of the output.

- [Software Bills of Materials · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sboms): An SBOM is a complete inventory of the components in a piece of software, the prerequisite for knowing whether you are exposed to a given flaw.

- [Scaling Challenges · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/scaling-challenges): Growing from hundreds to the millions of qubits fault tolerance needs runs into wiring, heat, control, calibration, and error-correction bottlenecks at once.

- [World Models · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/world-models-rl): A world model learns to predict how an environment evolves, letting an agent train and plan inside its own simulation.
- [Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET)](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/worst-case-execution-time): L1 certifies every critical path by its provable worst-case execution time, computed from fabric structure rather than measured averages.
- [XGBoost · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/xgboost): XGBoost is a fast, regularized gradient-boosting library that dominates tabular benchmarks through engineering and second-order optimization.
- [XNOR Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/xnor-gate): The XNOR gate outputs 1 when its inputs are equal; it is the complement of XOR and acts as an equality detector.
- [XOR Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/xor-gate): The XOR gate outputs 1 when its inputs differ, implementing exclusive-OR and modulo-2 addition of bits.
- [XOR in Arithmetic and Logic · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/xor-gate-usage): The exclusive-OR gate is the workhorse of digital arithmetic, comparison, parity, and controllable inversion.
- [XX+YY Exchange Gate · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/xx-plus-yy-gate): An excitation-conserving two-qubit gate that mixes the single-excitation states while leaving zero- and double-excitation states fixed.
- [Youla Parametrization · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/youla-parametrization): The Youla parametrization describes every stabilizing controller for a plant with a single free stable transfer function, making closed-loop maps affine.
- [Z-Algorithm · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/z-algorithm): A linear-time method that computes, for each position, the length of the longest substring starting there that matches a prefix.
- [The Z-Transform · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/z-transform): The z-transform maps discrete-time sequences to functions of a complex variable, turning difference equations into algebra.
- [Z2 Gauge Theory and the Toric Code · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/z2-gauge-theory-and-toric-code): The toric code is the ground-state sector of a Z2 lattice gauge theory, a link that explains its stabilizers, charges, and fluxes in physical terms.
- [Zero-Noise Extrapolation · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/zero-noise-extrapolation): Deliberately amplifying noise, measuring the result at several noise levels, and extrapolating back to the zero-noise limit.
- [Zero-Trust Architecture · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/zero-trust-architecture): A security model that never grants trust by network location, verifying every request explicitly regardless of where it originates.
- [Zero-Trust Identity and Mutual TLS](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/zero-trust-identity): Every workload, FPGA node, and service holds a short-lived cryptographic identity and proves it on every connection, so trust follows the credential, not the wire.
- [Ziegler-Nichols Tuning · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ziegler-nichols): The Ziegler-Nichols rules give quick starting PID gains from a single closed-loop or open-loop experiment on the plant.
- [ZYZ Euler Decomposition · Kronos AI · Quantum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/zyz-euler-decomposition): Any single-qubit gate as three rotations about the Z and Y axes, the standard way to lower a 2x2 unitary to hardware.
